title: AURORA-M: Open Source Continual Pre-training for Multilingual Language and Code

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance across a diverse set of languages (English, Finnish, Hindi, Japanese, Vietnamese) on localized NLP benchmarks (e.g., MMLU, HellaSwag, XWINO, JSQuAD) to measure and alleviate performance disparities between English and non-English texts.

Manual evaluation and scoring (Continual Alignment Redteam Percentage) of model responses to adversarial red-teaming prompts (Biden-Harris Redteam Testset and DangerousQA) by human volunteers to identify harmful, toxic, hateful, or biased outputs.
